Data:H.present.ability.hint.json.label: Present What?
Data:H.present.ability.hint.json.startdescription: [Add an Element of the Soul to win a victory. Or record a History in your Journal to win a major one.]

Data:H.present.ability.history.hint.json.label: Present a History?
Data:H.present.ability.history.hint.json.startdescription: Here I stand. What will be lost? [You've established History. Are you ready to present it before the Earl's Yew?]

Data:H.present.journal.hint.json.label: Stand before the Tree?

Data:H.present.journal.season.hint.json.label: When Numa Comes...

Data:H.record.already.json.label: This History
Data:H.record.already.json.startdescription: I've recorded a History already. I should present it to the sea, the sky, and the earth, in Earl Brian's Field... in the season of Numa.

Data:H.record.aspect.hint.json.label: More?
Data:H.record.aspect.hint.json.startdescription: I can try to record a History - a truth that the Hours themselves may honour and agree. But this is not done lightly. [To record a History, provide a Numen, and at least 25 of a fundamental Aspect. This will be easier if you've made at least one matching Determination.]
